newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Hungry Nigerian civil servant dies in pay queue.
newsitem.headline: Hungry Nigerian civil servant dies in pay queue.

text.p: A Nigerian civil servant died from exhaustion while queuing for hours over the weekend to collect monthly wages of 1,500 naira ($20), witnesses said on Monday.
"He complained he had not eaten for two days as he was without money," said one of his colleagues, who declined to be named.
George Adeleye, a 46-year-old father of five, had been employed by the Ministry of Works in Lagos for 20 years.
Nigeria's civil servants are often forced to wait weeks or even months for their salaries to be paid.
